channel.title: Paksh: Economy
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Energy suppliers warn of winter crisis, urge government action
item.description: Energy suppliers are warning of the worst winter energy crisis since 2022 and are urging the government to take immediate action to help households struggling with bills. Energy UK, a trade body, stated that immediate action is needed to… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: US Federal Reserve likely to hold interest rates steady in October
item.description: The US Federal Reserve is likely to hold interest rates steady in October, with a top official signaling the central bank's intention. This potential pause comes as the US labor market shows signs of cooling more than anticipated… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Europe's Gas Storage Levels Raise Supply Shortage Fears
item.description: Europe's gas storage levels have reached 71% as winter approaches, sparking concerns about potential supply shortages and increased prices. Global gasoline prices are also expected to remain elevated due to ongoing supply constraints. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: G20 Nations Divided Over US Trade Proposals
item.description: During a G20 meeting, the United States faced pushback from other member nations regarding its proposals on excess industrial capacity and forced labor. These trade divisions have widened among the participating countries. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has determined that a software glitch affecting certain flight computers on Boeing's 737 Max 10 aircraft does not pose a safety risk. This finding provides a boost to the certification process… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.description: Shri Uday Samant Ji, Cabinet Minister for Industries and Marathi Language, inaugurated the 10th edition of the India Gem & Jewellery Show (GJS 2026 Diwali Edition). The event is organized by the GJC. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Russian Uranium Reaches Bangladesh for Nuclear Plant
item.description: A shipment of Russian uranium has arrived in Bangladesh for the Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant. The fuel is intended for the plant's first unit. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: RBI Appoints Sudhakar Malli as New Executive Director
item.description: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has appointed Sudhakar Malli as its new Executive Director. In his new role, Malli will oversee bank supervision. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Unified Payments Interface (UPI) transactions saw a substantial increase in the first half of the financial year 2027. Approximately 145 billion transactions were processed, with their total value reaching Rs 177 lakh crore. This growth… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Nayara Energy, India's largest private fuel retailer, has increased the prices of petrol by Rs 5 per litre and diesel by Rs 3 per litre, effective immediately. This decision is attributed to rising international crude oil prices and… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 6 · Right 0.

item.description: India has reduced import duties on edible oils to help lower domestic prices. The duty on crude palm oil and crude soybean oil was cut from 10% to 5%. Additionally, the import duty on crude sunflower oil has been reduced to zero. Following… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Indian Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal was scheduled to meet with US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer to discuss the early conclusion of an interim trade agreement between the two countries. The talks come amid a US threat of 100%… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 8 · Right 1.

item.description: Amazon is offering discounts on five Samsung phone models, with prices starting at ₹16,999, including foldable phones. Flipkart's Big Billion Days sale will feature discounts on Google Pixel smartphones. It is noted that Google Pixel… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Indian Auto Sales Soften in September After August Records
item.description: Shares of Indian auto companies declined in September after reaching record highs in August. Hyundai reported record sales for September, selling 77,916 units, a significant increase from previous periods. Other auto companies also saw… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 3.

item.title: Jammu and Kashmir auctions two mineral blocks
item.description: Jammu and Kashmir has successfully auctioned two mineral blocks, marking a significant development in the region's mining sector. This event is described as a "historic first" for J&K, signaling the commencement of mining development. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Nike Announces Job Cuts and Restructuring for Savings
item.description: Nike, the world's largest footwear company, is implementing a restructuring plan that includes job cuts and aims to achieve $2.5 billion in savings. The company is deepening its restructuring under CEO Elliott Hill to boost its turnaround… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 5 · Right 0.

item.description: Reliance Industries is planning significant investments in India. In Andhra Pradesh, the company will invest ₹1 lakh crore to establish Compressed Bio Gas (CBG) plants, a project expected to create 3 lakh jobs and generate ₹60,000 crore in… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Africa's Richest Man Launches Kenya Oil Refinery
item.description: Alhaji Aliko Dangote, described as Africa's richest man, has launched an oil refinery in Kenya. The refinery is part of a larger plan to industrialize Africa by 2030. The project involves a $300 million deal with US firm Honeywell and has… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Gold and Silver Prices See Significant Fluctuations
item.description: Gold prices are nearing ₹1.39 lakh, while silver has seen a substantial drop of ₹6,000. These price movements are being reported across various cities, including Indore and Raipur, with consumers advised to check local rates. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 5 · Right 2.

item.title: G7 Agrees to Release Diesel Reserves Amid Rising Fuel Prices
item.description: Leaders from the G7 nations have agreed to release 100 million barrels of diesel and other reserves through the International Energy Agency (IEA) in response to rising global fuel prices. The decision follows pressure from the United… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 5 · Right 0.

item.title: UK Household Energy Bills Set for Significant Rise
item.description: Millions of households in Great Britain are facing an increase in their annual energy bills, with a typical home's cost rising by 4% to an average of £1,723 per year starting Thursday. Forecasts indicate a further potential increase of 16%… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Piyush Goyal seeks WTO-compliant trade measures at G20 meet
item.description: Union Minister Piyush Goyal met with his counterparts from France, Canada, Saudi Arabia, and South Korea during the G20 Trade Ministers' meeting in the US. The discussions focused on enhancing bilateral trade relations and addressing… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 6 · Right 1.

item.description: U.S. Treasury Secretary Bessent and the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) are taking action against a tax strategy reportedly used by the wealthy to avoid capital gains taxes. This strategy involves investing in certain Exchange Traded Funds… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: IG Group Shares Plunge After Slashed Future Guidance
item.description: Shares of the spreadbetter IG Group experienced a significant decline, diving 27% after the company drastically reduced its financial guidance for 2026. The trading platform's announcement led to a substantial drop in its stock value. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Fuel Prices Rise, Impacting Consumers and Businesses
item.description: Rising fuel prices are increasing costs for consumers and businesses, including charities. US refiners are reportedly experiencing windfall profits due to these escalating fuel costs, which are influenced by global conflicts. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Investors Shift Funds From France Amidst Growing Concerns
item.description: Investors are reportedly shifting capital away from France, with some directing funds towards Britain. This movement of investment comes as concerns about France's economic or political stability appear to be deepening, leading some… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Energy Transition Faces Scrutiny Amidst Broken Promises
item.description: Commentary pieces suggest the energy transition, once hailed as a solution, is now facing significant challenges and is being viewed as a broken promise. The discourse indicates that the transition is beginning to feed itself, implying a… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Etihad Rail Adds Trains Between Abu Dhabi and Dubai
item.description: Etihad Rail has launched a train service connecting Abu Dhabi and Dubai. Following a surge in demand, the company has added six extra trains to the route. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Italy and Greece Seek EU Fiscal Rule Flexibility
item.description: Italy and Greece are seeking flexibility from European Union fiscal rules, with Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni requesting leeway from Brussels. This comes as an energy shock is squeezing Italy's economy. The specific nature of the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: US Jobs Market Slows Ahead of Midterm Elections
item.description: The United States jobs market experienced a significant slowdown, with employers pausing hiring as unemployment rose slightly. This development occurred just a month before the midterm elections. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: US Mortgage Rates Reach Near 3-Year High
item.description: US mortgage rates have climbed to their highest level in nearly three years. The increase has implications for potential homebuyers. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Jammu & Kashmir Notifies Electric Vehicle Policy 2026
item.description: Jammu and Kashmir has notified its Electric Vehicle Policy 2026, aiming to promote green transportation. The policy targets the adoption of 1.4 lakh electric vehicles by 2032. The notification was met with congratulations from Chief… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Bihar's Makhana Exported to Greece with APEDA Support
item.description: A one-tonne consignment of makhana (fox nuts) from Bihar has been exported to Greece, with support from the Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority (APEDA). The export signifies an expansion of Bihar's makhana… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: India's GST Revenue Surges Past ₹2 Lakh Crore in September
item.description: Goods and Services Tax (GST) revenue in India surpassed ₹2 lakh crore in September. Andhra Pradesh specifically recorded a 14.10% increase in its GST collections for the same month. This marks a significant rise in national tax revenue. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Adani Ports Reports 11% Cargo Growth in September
item.description: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone reported an 11% year-on-year increase in cargo volume for September, reaching 46 million metric tons (MMT). For the first half of the fiscal year 2027 (H1 FY27), the company's cargo volume grew by 15%… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.
